meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把文件夹、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚才对话里做过的事,提炼成一个可复用的技能,产出或更新 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md 文件(必要时附脚本、参考与模板)。仅靠现有工具完成,不调用额外引擎。
howto.when: 当用户说“/learn”“capture this workflow”等,或要求把某个目录/网址/内容做成技能、改进已有技能时触发。不处理“从商店安装现成技能”的请求。

say.text: 把刚才我们一步步做的部署流程整理成一个技能。
say.note: 会从当前对话提取步骤并生成 SKILL.md。

say.text: 改一下“wow-on-steam-deck”技能,补上刚才踩到的坑。
say.note: 读取已有技能并就地更新、去重。

howto.what_en: Distills any source (directory, URL, pasted notes, or the just-completed conversation) into a reusable skill by creating or updating .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, using only existing tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “/learn”, “capture this workflow”, or similar, or asks to make a skill from a source or improve/update an existing skill. Does not install existing skills.

say_en.text: Turn the deployment steps we just did into a skill.
say_en.note: Extracts steps from this conversation and writes a SKILL.md.

say_en.text: /learn https://docs.example.com/api — make a usage skill from this doc.
say_en.note: Fetches the page and distills the steps.

say_en.text: Refine the 'wow-on-steam-deck' skill with the gotcha we just hit.
say_en.note: Reads the existing skill and updates it in place.
